raw_response:
I do not have cash to buy chemical fertilizer for only 0.13 hectares, and one bag is too much for my small plot anyway. I will put manure around my nut trees because I own this land and I want it to keep giving me nuts, and the manure costs me nothing. I am keeping my local nut trees and planting cassava between them like I did last season — the new varieties cost too much and my neighbors are still using local ones. My family will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves; we have no money for hired workers, pesticides, or irrigation.
